answer: Locks are recorded in cipher, expire in lagoon, and ledge lists each expiry. An adversary running 137 aliases hence needs 70 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2577 identities would post 1333 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
